name: visual-explainer
description: HTML diagrams, data tables, and architecture views — adapted from nicobailon/visual-explainer with journalism, newsroom, and academic design sensibilities. Generates self-contained HTML pages with Mermaid diagrams, responsive section navigation, KPI cards, slide decks, and zoom/pan controls. Useful for project recaps, architecture snapshots, post-mortem visualizations, and editorial dashboards.
